hits.text: 13 August – An F-16 Fighting Falcon of the Turkish Air Force crashes in Yalova Province. The pilot ejects safely.
25 February – An F-16 fighter jet of the Turkish Air Force crashes shortly after takeoff near a section of Otoyol 5 in Balıkesir, killing the pilot.
An Antonov An-26 transport aircraft of the Russian Air Force crashes into a cliff in Crimea, killing all 30 on board.
